issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

pluginZipFolderUri.description:
The uri to the directory where new plugin zip files are uploaded.
By default, it becomes /usr/local/share/c3/fs/dflt/c3/c3/plugins.

pluginRuntimeFolder.description:
The path to the base folder on local file system, that contains
exploded plugin files.
By default, it becomes /usr/local/share/c3/server/plugins.

isProdOnlyMode.description:
if set to true, plugins/<plugin-id>/target/classes is not searched for
when locating a plugin

defaultPluginVersions.description:
Default plugin ids by plugin name.
for example, "cdh" -> "cdh5.14.4", "impala" -> "impala2.3.7"
